high_level_description: The image is a photograph of three medals displayed on a white surface with sketches of the medal designs in the background. The medals are arranged in a triangular formation, with one gold medal at the top and two silver medals below it. Medals: The gold medal has a hexagonal center with radiating lines and the text "Paris 2024" inscribed around it. The two silver medals also have hexagonal centers with radiating lines but are slightly different in design compared to the gold medal. They both feature the same text as the gold medal: "Paris 2024."
